Current city demo comparison, 2026-11-24

Current source was a clean isolated checkout at
35577d9c45d518dd6781089346ef57e3c84273d7. The 14 cases in historical-city-demo-arm64.txt were captured independently
from current source, each in its own process and Game tests-lane invocation.
The complete current output matched the stored historical f8 rows byte for
byte; the identical rows are stored once. The independently captured current
output is also retained in isolated comparison commit c9d4d40b.
The original refusal records were not altered.

The same public selected geometry producer and bounded driver used for the
f8 capture were used here. They use zero placement, seeds 5 and 11, detail
demo, and the full geometry/material fingerprint. The driver enforced a
120-second wall limit, 4-GiB sampled RSS limit and a 30-GiB free-space floor;
no guard tripped. Darwin arm64, go1.27.3, default GOEXPERIMENT, GOWORK=off,
GOMAXPROCS=2, GOFLAGS='-p=1 -parallel=1 -timeout=60m'. The JSONL log retains
each elapsed time and sampled RSS peak; samples are not guaranteed maxima.
